In the Sachs et al. flow cytometry network, which this dataset matches, PLCγ and MEK have no direct edge. PLCγ connects to PIP2 and PIP3. MEK is regulated by Raf, PKC and PKA. Any correlation between pmek and plcg would therefore come from shared upstream signalling, not a direct cause. I answered from that published network and did not run any analysis on `flow.csv`.

ANSWER: C
